manifest.name: Resend
manifest.description: Resend is a modern email API for developers. Send transactional emails, manage domains, and track delivery with a simple REST API.

endpoints.description: Send a transactional email with HTML or text body.
endpoints.response_description: Returns email id and delivery status.

authentication.instructions: Create an API key at resend.com; send Authorization: Bearer <key>.

manifest.agent_notes: Sign up at resend.com for an API key. Authentication uses Bearer token in the Authorization header. Pricing is freemium with a free tier for development; see resend.com/pricing for production limits.
